name: @luke/host-daemon
description: Luke's host daemon: a headless Linux box's own follower of the local agents its member starts on it, and the install script that sets it up

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node24 --outfile=dist/luke-host.mjs --define:process.env.LUKE_HOST_VERSION='"'$npm_package_version'"' --define:PACKAGED_WITH_DEVELOPER_ID_SIGNING=${LUKE_HOST_DEVELOPER_ID_SIGNED:-false} --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
